column1: # Moonstone 2026 regression goldens.  Columns are TAB-separated:
#   name <tab> kind <tab> input <tab> frame <tab> golden
# kind=ramfnv : cold-boot to <frame>, FNV-1a hash of all RAM == golden  (engine/behaviour)
#   input is "cold" (ignored).  Catches any unintended change to game behaviour.
# kind=framesha : loadstate <input>.sav, render frame <frame>, SHA-256 == golden  (display)
#   input is a save filename under dist/MoonstoneNative/ (local, not in repo).
# Re-baseline after an INTENTIONAL change:  python recomp/regress/check.py --update
# kind=savefnv : loadstate <input>.sav (frozen fixture, under dist/MoonstoneNative/),
#   run <frame> frames with --os, FNV-1a of all RAM == golden.  Exercises GAMEPLAY
#   paths (combat AI, sound protocol, PC hooks) the cold goldens never reach.
# ramfnv input "os" = full HLE boot running the real attract; frame 4000 covers the
#   window (2000-3000) where an unguarded hook misfire once hid from the 500-frame golden.
determinism
attract
combatrun
vanishrun
townday
townarmor
combat
overland
# Retail-parity goldens (the SHIPPING default: g_retail_parity ON).  Same fixtures
# as the cracked-baseline rows above; kind prefix "p+" runs without --noretailparity.
# B3 rat-kill correction, 2026-09-21: seven intentional RAM-byte changes only:
# the retail no-new-animation sentinel and an untouched inactive display workspace.
# All 600 rendered frames, one-life loss and frame-363 round exit match the old
# build. Original retail transition/reaction comparisons: check_knockout.py.
# Sep24 B15 cursor RNG: original native RNG runs once per active cursor tick.
# combatrun changes only the seed and five inactive stack bytes after death.
# townday changes the seed, AI selection pointer and cached mouse/JOY0 bytes.
# townarmor's later AI fight changes with the new stream. Supplying that stream
# to the frozen old EXE reproduces its complete pictures/audio and gameplay RAM;
# --nocursorrng restores all three previous hashes exactly. See check_cursor_rng.py
# and notes-handoff/moonstone-rng.md. Parity-off goldens remain unchanged.
# Oct7 CON/END limit mapping: six inventory bytes change (the two captions,
# plus each cached hotspot's label pointer and action). All 600 rendered frames
# and audio match the prior build; --nostatcapfix restores all RAM exactly.
combatrunP
vanishrunP
# Sep23 restored city Exit click: only native audio state changes (channel
# selector at 3aa7a and channel record at 43068). 340 paired town captures match;
# --noretailsfx restores the complete previous RAM. See moonstone-menu-sounds.md.
towndayP
# Sep21 AI XP: only RAM byte 0x2e8af changes 0->1 after native AI victory;
# --noaixpfix exactly reproduces 384dc55d. See moonstone-ai-xp.md.

townarmorP
